{{Top|leg}}
'''Katarn armor Mark IV''' was a variant of [[Katarn armor]] used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
[[File:KatarnIIandIV.jpg|thumb|Spacers wearing Katarn armor Mark IV (Right) and II (Left)]]
It had [[Color/Legends|red]] markings and a black-colored [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], and was the only variant of [[Katarn armor]] that was still in use by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. This version of armor somewhat resembled those worn the [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]].
